subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 26, 2026
body:
The intelligence sync commit merged newsletter, archive, wiki guides, and feed, streamlining project documentation for AcreetionOS. Natalie spivanatalie64 and Darren cobra3282000 pushed the sync to acreetionos-code.github.io, unifying community resources under a single update. This milestone means readers now get a single, coherent feed from the homepage, changelog, docs, and wiki without hunting scattered pages.

Development / The sync also touched the ISO pipeline. Recent commits in AcreetionOS-Xlibre show nightly updates, and the CI now publishes polished ISOs daily from the flash.html endpoint. If you missed the latest build, grab it at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html and be among the first to test new features. The changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html records each CI run, so you can track progress or report issues directly.

Community / Friday’s security updates patched a critical root‑privilege flaw in a core Arch package, closing the window left by the fake Arch Linux script that once sneaked malicious code onto systems. Users are urged to run `sudo pacman -Syu` and verify the fix against the latest entry in the changelog. Meanwhile, the Shelly 3.1.9 GUI Package Manager arrived with improved AUR support, making it easier to add and maintain community repositories safely.

Tip of the day / After updating, run `pacman -Qdt` to clean orphaned packages and keep the system trim. If you’re new, the docs at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html walk you through the full workflow, from flash creation to post‑install tweaks. Enjoy the smoother experience and keep the community secure.
